svg.title: IRIS: a visual tokenizer, an autoregressive world model, and imagined actor-critic learning
svg.metadata: IRIS paper · model overview: https://arxiv.org/html/2209.00588v2 | Prediction heads · world_model.py: https://github.com/eloialonso/iris/blob/main/src/models/world_model.py | Decode path · world_model_env.py: https://github.com/eloialonso/iris/blob/main/src/envs/world_model_env.py | IRIS actor–critic code: https://github.com/eloialonso/iris/blob/main/src/models/actor_critic.py | IRIS tokenizer objectives: https://github.com/eloialonso/iris/blob/main/src/models/tokenizer/tokenizer.py

text.tspan: IRIS: a visual tokenizer, an autoregressive world model, and imagined actor-critic
A frame becomes a vocabulary; dynamics become a sequence.
Original IRIS · a visual tokenizer and a causal Transformer have separate training objectives.

g.title: A frame becomes a vocabulary; dynamics become a sequence.
g.desc: Original IRIS · a visual tokenizer and a causal Transformer have separate training objectives. The visual encoder and codebook turn each image into discrete IDs. Actions occupy their own positions in the temporal sequence. A decoder trains the visual vocabulary through reconstruction. The causal Transformer receives token IDs; its objective does not update the tokenizer. Separate heads predict observation tokens, reward, and episode end. Cross-entropy trains these discrete predictions. Grid size is illustrative; K depends on the tokenizer. Action embeddings and observation embeddings are separate. The causal mask prevents access to future sequence positions.

text.tspan: Grid size is illustrative; K depends on the tokenizer. Action embeddings and observation embeddings are separate. The causal
mask prevents access to future sequence positions.
The policy sees an image decoded from imagination.
Original IRIS · the actor–critic interacts with the world model through an image interface.

g.title: The policy sees an image decoded from imagination.
g.desc: Original IRIS · the actor–critic interacts with the world model through an image interface. Predicted visual tokens are decoded back to pixels before the actor consumes them. The actor’s convolutional network processes the imagined image. An LSTM retains temporal context. The actor supplies the next action token to the world model. Reward and end predictions supply the imagined learning signals. The action enters the next Transformer step. The imagined environment is evaluated without actor gradients through the world model. Layer counts follow the original IRIS implementation.
